title: ExternalVolumeMount
description: Configuration of a volume mount for the Python UDF container that executes the managed function.

sourcePath.description: Optional. The absolute path of the source to be mounted, only support Google Cloud Storage bucket or folder now. Eg: gs://bucket-xxx for Google Cloud Storage bucket, gs://bucket-xxx/folder1/folder2 for Google Cloud Storage folder.

mountPath.description: Optional. The absolute path within the container where the volume should be mounted.
